info.title: FitVibe API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the FitVibe REST API. Generated from documentation anchors until automated zod-to-openapi wiring is complete.

patch.summary: Update a session (details, schedule, status, exercises)
patch.description:
Partial update: only the fields sent change. There is no ETag or If-Match check; the last write wins.

Scheduling: a session occupies [planned_at, planned_at + planned_duration_min). A change of `planned_at` or `planned_duration_min` that overlaps another active session of the same user is refused with 422 `E.SESSION.SCHEDULE_CONFLICT`, listing the blocking sessions in `error.details.conflictingSessionIds`. Back-to-back sessions do not conflict; canceled sessions occupy no time; a session being canceled is not checked.

Status: allowed transitions are planned → in_progress | completed | canceled and in_progress → completed | canceled. `started_at` and `completed_at` default to the time of the change. Changing a completed session's plan, schedule, timestamps, calories or exercises requires reopening it first (409 `E.SESSION.REOPEN_REQUIRED`).

Sending `exercises` replaces the session's exercises and sets.

200.description: The updated session with its exercises.

400.description: Invalid body (`error` is the zod field report), an invalid status transition (`E.SESSION.INVALID_STATUS`) or a plan the user does not own (`E.SESSION.INVALID_PLAN`).

409.description: `E.SESSION.REOPEN_REQUIRED`: reopen the completed session before correcting it.

422.description: `E.SESSION.SCHEDULE_CONFLICT`: the new time overlaps other sessions.

patch.summary: Record, correct or skip a set
patch.description: completed stores the performed values (a correction keeps the first recorded_at); skipped clears them. The set's prescription is never changed.

200.description: The whole workout after the change.

409.description: `E.SESSION.NOT_ACTIVE`: the workout is not in progress.

422.description: `E.SESSION.INVALID_SET`: a skipped set cannot have performed values.

post.description: Appends the exercise (source added) with one empty planned set. Supports Idempotency-Key.

post.description: Public, CSRF-protected and rate-limited. Reports carry no identity; the server strips query strings, fragments and email addresses before logging.

locale.description: UI language of the request; used for the email it sends.

sex.description: Opaque reference code validated against the genders catalog.

weight_kg.description: Validated against the configured weight bio-attribute range.

fitness_level.description: Opaque reference code validated against the fitness_levels catalog.

weight.description: Weight in weightUnit; must be within the 20–400 kg equivalent range.

status.description: completed logs a past workout in one request: started_at = planned_at, completed_at = planned_at + planned_duration_min (not later than now). planned_at must not be in the future (422 E.SESSION.LOG_IN_FUTURE).

completion_outcome.description: Only with status completed; defaults to completed.

planned_duration_min.description: Planned length in minutes; defaults to 60.

status.description: An exercise is done when its sets are; skipped is an explicit athlete action (ADR-043).

source.description: prescribed: part of the plan; added: added while training.
